subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Rack and Pinion: Rotation to Translation
description: Learn Rack and Pinion: Rotation to Translation in one minute.

hook.text: Turn the steering wheel and the car's front wheels pivot. How?

buildup.text: A small gear (pinion) meshes with a flat toothed bar (rack) to push it sideways.

discovery.text: Rotation of the pinion becomes precise linear motion of the rack.

twist.text: The ratio is simple: one pinion revolution moves the rack by one pitch circle.

climax.text: Rack and pinion steering replaced older recirculating-ball systems in most cars.

punchline.text: Spin a gear on a flat bar and straight lines appear.

quiz.question: How does a rack and pinion convert motion?
options: The rack slides to spin the pinion at variable speed
Pinion rotation moves the flat rack in a straight line
Both rack and pinion rotate around fixed axes
